# Uptimerobot

UptimeRobot is a service that monitors the uptime and performance of websites, applications, and services, providing real-time alerts and detailed logs.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/uptimerobot/.

## Actions

- **Add Monitor**: Create a new monitor.
- **Delete Monitor**: Delete a monitor.
- **Edit Monitor**: Edit an existing monitor.
- **Get Account Details** (read-only): Retrieve account details.
- **Get Monitors** (read-only): Fetch monitor details and status.
- **Get Public Status Pages** (read-only): Retrieve public status pages.
- **New Maintenance Window**: Create a new maintenance window.
- **New Public Status Page**: Create a new public status page.
- **Edit Maintenance Window**: Edit an existing maintenance window.
- **Edit Public Status Page**: Edit an existing public status page.
- **Get Maintenance Windows** (read-only): Retrieve maintenance windows.
- **Get Monitor Authentication Type** (read-only): Get authentication type for specified monitors.
- **Get Monitor Custom HTTP Headers** (read-only): Retrieve custom http headers for specified monitors.
- **Get Monitor Custom HTTP Statuses** (read-only): Retrieve custom http statuses for specified monitors.
- **Get Monitor Response Times** (read-only): Fetch historical response times for specified monitors.
- **Get Monitor SSL Certificate Info** (read-only): Retrieve ssl certificate information for specified monitors.
- **Get Monitor Timezone** (read-only): Retrieve timezone for specified monitors.
- **Get Uptime Ratios** (read-only): Retrieve uptime ratios for monitors.
